messages.text: Jones warns England: You were good vs Japan, but All Blacks will be 'violent'

metadata.summary: Former England head coach Eddie Jones praised his old side as "very good" as they tore his Japan apart 78-15 on Saturday, but warned the All Blacks will be "violent" against them next week.
metadata.content: Eddie Jones warns England: You were very good against my Japan, but All Blacks will be 'violent' next week after Wales loss | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Eddie Jones warns England: You were very good against my Japan, but All Blacks will be 'violent' next week after Wales loss Eddie Jones warns England the All Blacks will be 'violent' at Twickenham next week; Will Joseph scored five as England registered 13 tries in huge Nations Championship victory, with Jones' Japan alarmingly inferior; Steve Borthwick admits he now has 'thinking' to do around selection Michael Cantillon Sports Journalist Saturday 14 November 2026 20:41, UK Image: Former England head coach Eddie Jones threw a warning their way ahead of the All Blacks visiting Twickenham next week Former England head coach Eddie Jones praised his old side as "very good" as they tore his Japan apart 78-15 on Saturday, but warned the All Blacks will be "violent" against them next week. Following South Africa's defeat to France in Paris on Friday, victory for New Zealand against Wales in Cardiff would have seen them claim World Rugby's No 1 ranking, and take charge of the Nations Championship southern hemisphere table. Instead, the All Blacks suffered their first defeat to Wales since 1953 in a shock 35-28 loss up against an immense Welsh defensive effort, and next play England at Twickenham next Saturday. messages.text: Andreeva eliminates Pegula to set WTA Finals title match with Svitolina

metadata.summary: Mirra Andreeva took a straight-sets victory over Jessica Pegula at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells.
metadata.content: WTA Finals: Mirra Andreeva eliminates Jessica Pegula to reach final, winning in straight sets after 'diva' criticism | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content WTA Finals: Mirra Andreeva eliminates Jessica Pegula to reach final, winning in straight sets after 'diva' criticism Mirra Andreeva beat Jessica Pegula in straight sets in their semi-final to reach the title match at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells; They were playing each other after Pegula was overheard calling Andreeva a "diva" earlier in the tournament; Andreeva had the last word, winning 6-3 6-4 Saturday 14 November 2026 23:30, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Mirra Andreeva against Jessica Pegula from the semi-finals at the WTA Finals. Mirra Andreeva took a straight-sets victory over Jessica Pegula at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells. Andreeva's 6-3 6-4 victory saw her advance to the final at the year-end tournament in California, making her the first teenager to reach the title match at the WTA Finals since 2004. Andreeva and Pegula were playing one another for the first time in their careers and their match-up in the last four came after Pegula had been picked up on a hot mic criticising Andreeva at the start of the tournament. In a livestreamed practice session, Pegula was heard labelling Andreeva a "diva" who "needs to be humbled". Image: Andreeva is in excellent form at the season-ending tournament. messages.text: Immense Wales pull off sensational first victory over All Blacks since 1953
